warmup.name: Couch stretch
warmup.note: Tuck the pelvis BEFORE you lean. Hips stop you before the knee does.

warmup.name: Seated 90/90 hip switch
warmup.note: Slow, no hands if you can.

warmup.name: 90/90 push-up
warmup.note: From 90/90, torso down over the front leg to the floor and back. Hands assist at first; goal is the glute lifting you unaided.

warmup.name: Side plank
warmup.note: One hold per side. Knees or feet. No top-leg raise.

warmup.name: Side-lying hip abduction
warmup.note: NEW - you asked for this on 08-09. Straight top leg, lift to ~30 deg, no rolling back. If you still cannot feel the glute after two sessions, say so and it comes back out.

warmup.name: Seated good morning, unloaded
warmup.note: No bar. Hinge-pattern stretch, working toward depth.

warmup.name: Straddle hold
warmup.note: Capped at 60 s so it does not pre-fatigue the box squat.

A.session_notes: NEW 4-day rotation, ~45-50 min. Overhead day. Machine shoulder press replaces the barbell OHP (no plate loading); the barbell is still a variant. Pec deck is straight sets now, preacher curl is the finisher. Core and glutes today come from the warm-up.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press - top set
exercises.notes: 40 is your barbell number (40x5 RPE 7). On a machine: First time on a machine = baseline: find RPE 7-8 for the reps and log it. Weights don't carry between variants. Never behind the neck.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press - back-off
exercises.notes: Barbell: 35x8 (you did 8 and 7). Machine: ~85% of the top set. Ribs down.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45 (partial ROM)
exercises.notes: Held at 140 (3x8 RPE 8). Knee is the boss.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: +5: 45 was 3x10 at RPE 8. Chest up, pull to the collarbone. RPE 8 cap, stop on any catch in the back.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
exercises.notes: Straight sets now, not a drop set. Nearest pin to 40 (47 to failure gave 10). RPE 7 or under = 43 next time.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: 35 -> 25 -> 20. 30 gave 13 on the first drop, so +5. Want 10-12 on the first drop.

B.session_notes: NEW 4-day rotation. Chest day. Squat moves to a machine (pendulum / perfect squat / hack) so you don't have to load a bar; barbell box squat only as a last resort. Hip thrust on a machine where there is one. Calf raises in the bench and row rests.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - top set
exercises.notes: Held at 75 (RPE 8). Heaviest set first.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - back-off
exercises.notes: Held at 60 (7, 7 at RPE 9). First rep of each set paused 2 s. Calf raises in these rests.

exercises.name: Squat Machine
exercises.notes: Matrix perfect squat: 10x10 was RPE 7, so 20. Pendulum or hack: First time on a machine = baseline: find RPE 7-8 for the reps and log it. Weights don't carry between variants. Depth the knee allows.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: 20 for 12 now (3x10 at RPE 8). RPE 8 cap. Calf raises in these rests.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Barbell: 3x15 at 20 was clean, so 25x12, only if your back was fine after 10-18; otherwise 20x15. Machine: First time on a machine = baseline: find RPE 7-8 for the reps and log it. Weights don't carry between variants. Ribs down, 2 s squeeze, stop at straight. Any lower back = end the set.

exercises.name: Lying Incline DB Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: 10 -> 7.5 -> 5. You got 8 on the first drop, so hold 10. Want 10-12.

C.session_notes: NEW 4-day rotation. Back + hinge day. Back extension goes to 3x8 BW at RPE 6-7. Hammer curl is the finisher, straight sets. Wrist + reverse curl superset goes in the back extension rests.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - top set
exercises.notes: Held at +5 (RPE 8). Stop the set AND the exercise on any catch in the back.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - back-off
exercises.notes: Bodyweight, 4 -> 5 reps (RPE 7).

exercises.name: 45 Back Extension (stop at neutral)
exercises.notes: 2x8 was RPE 6, so a 3rd set. Squeeze glutes, chin tucked, STOP AT NEUTRAL, never arch. Wrist + reverse curl superset in these rests.

exercises.name: DB Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: 20 gave 12/10/8 at RPE 10. Hold 20 and get all three sets to 10.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (half-kneeling)
exercises.notes: 10 per side, 2 s hold. Cables differ: 18 at your usual gym, ~11 on the other one.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Finisher, straight sets. 17.5 (no 18 kg DB). 2x8 was RPE 10, so hold and add a set.

D.session_notes: NEW DAY. Carry + core, plus what the other days miss. Squat machine is lighter than Day B (3x10). Dips cover chest and triceps. Suitcase hold is the carry. Lateral raise drop set to finish.

exercises.name: Squat Machine
exercises.notes: Lighter than Day B. Matrix: 10 for 10 was RPE 7, so 10x10 here. Pendulum or hack: First time on a machine = baseline: find RPE 7-8 for the reps and log it. Weights don't carry between variants.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.notes: +1 set at +5 kg (2x8 RPE 8). Stop at ~90 deg elbow, slight forward lean.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: +5: 3x15 at 30 was RPE 8. Rear delts and scap retraction, no body english.

exercises.name: Suitcase Hold (straps)
exercises.notes: Held at 24 (RPE 8). If the heaviest DB is 20, hold for 75 s. Ribs down, don't hitch the hip.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (drop set)
exercises.notes: 7.5 -> 5 -> 2.5. 7.5 gave 10/10/8 at RPE 10, so it starts here.

H.session_notes: Use this only to replace a missed gym day. It doesn't move the A/B/C rotation. Bodyweight only: every set ends 1-2 reps short of failure, or it doesn't count as growth work. Too easy (target hit at RPE 7)? Slow the lowering to 4-5 s or add a pause before adding reps. Pick the pull variant you actually did so the log stays honest.

exercises.name: Pike Push-up
exercises.notes: Feet on bed for harder, floor for easier. Head travels in front of the hands.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Rear foot on bed or chair, 3 s down. Slight forward lean, ribs down, never arch to go deeper. Knee sets the depth.

exercises.name: Pull
exercises.notes: Chin-up 8 (palms toward you), RPE 8 cap, stop on any catch. No bar: door-frame row 12 per side, feet closer to the frame = harder. Towel row: stand on the push-to-open side so pulling shuts the door.

exercises.name: Single-leg Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Shoulders on bed or sofa (floor = glute bridge). 2 s squeeze, ribs down, stop at neutral, never arch past straight.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.notes: Feet on bed if there is one. Floor: 3 s down, 1 s chest on floor. End the set when the hips sag.
